controversies.category: PILOT Tax Abatements & School Funding Exclusion
controversies.title: PILOT Tax Breaks vs. School District Revenues in Montville Township
controversies.entityInvolved: Township of Montville (Municipal & Fire Districts 1–3) vs. Montville Township Public Schools
controversies.summary: Long-term tax exemptions granted to major developments along commercial corridors bypass the school district (which normal takes 66.2% of property taxes), forcing existing homeowners to absorb student enrollment costs.
controversies.investigationDetails: Under New Jersey's Long Term Tax Exemption Law (N.J.S.A. 40A:20), municipalities can grant 30-year PILOTs where the developer pays an Annual Service Charge directly to Town Hall (95%) and the County (5%), while the public school district receives $0 statutory share. In Montville Township, where schools consume 66.2% of standard taxes, each new luxury residential unit adds student load without contributing ad valorem school tax support.
controversies.taxpayerImpact: Millions in abated school taxes shifted directly onto single-family homeowners across Montville Township.
controversies.status: Active community oversight and school board revenue-sharing debate.

controversies.title: 66.2% School Tax Reliance with Sub-8% State Aid & 3 Independent Fire Districts
controversies.summary: Because Montville receives less than 8% in NJ State Education Aid, local single-family homeowners shoulder 66.2% of the tax burden for Lazar Middle and Montville Twp High School, alongside separate tax rates across Fire Districts #1, #2, and #3.
controversies.investigationDetails: With inflation pushing employee healthcare past $28.6M and commercial ratables under pressure (15.9% of the tax base), Montville Township has had to manage tax levy growth against the 2% statutory cap, leading to school and municipal fiscal tension.
controversies.taxpayerImpact: Homeowners fund 84.1% of the property tax check, heightening public scrutiny on every budget line item.
controversies.status: Ongoing legislative and budget audit monitoring.
